scope: Independent read-only source review; no build/runtime/native/HWND/HTTP/account/GUI execution, no Candidate/lane edits.

findings.finding: captureProtection.acquire registers on EDT before inserting the lease into captureLeases. Another-thread close can CAS closed and enumerate old keys in that gap, missing the newly registered lease; subsequent insertion has no post-admission retirement recheck. KeepAwake already has the corresponding after-put check.
findings.minimalFix: After put, recheck fixed entry/closed/root predicate; if retired remove this token and close only its lease. Keep all EDT waits/native affinity outside Store/entry/native gates. Alternatively strictly serialize acquire and close on EDT, including the closed transition/map lifetime, and document that narrower API contract.

findings.finding: Stale predicates are removed only by refresh/acquire/availability/componentShown. orientationLocked reads live predicates but does not clear the applied affinity/state. Root must refresh and reacquire current original lock intent on real native source/entry retirement, including loading-null to first accepted source.
findings.minimalFix: Use an existing actual source/entry Flow/effect at Root; no new poller/capture authority. Same-version approved direct recovery correctly retains protection when account/request identity remains equal.

checkedBoundaries: Capture policy state distinguishes request/API result/failure and does not claim DRM/screenshot guarantee.
Native/EDT operations are outside gates by required construction/caller contract; onEdt is synchronous and must never be entered with Store/entry/native locks held.
Old capture lease removes only its token; replacement leases remain. HWND identity is checked before clears.
PiP presented=false hides actual popup and publishes unavailable without closing regions/disposal/content; Root must retain nonzero anchor geometry for that path.
Playback/deferred-exit subjects remain stricter exact accepted references; capture permits same-version/account/request direct recovery explicitly.
Root/window affinity only, no unrelated HWND or second native player/authority.
